input.code:
def process(all_data):
    df = all_data[all_data['Beach Type Description'] == 'Fresh'].copy()
    df['is_violation'] = df['Violation'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'yes'
    yearly = df.groupby('Year').agg(
        total=('is_violation', 'count'),
        violations=('is_violation', 'sum')
    ).reset_index()
    yearly['exceedance_rate'] = yearly['violations'] / yearly['total']
    avg_rate = round(yearly['exceedance_rate'].mean(), 2)
    yearly['above_avg'] = yearly['exceedance_rate'] > avg_rate
    yearly['avg_rate'] = avg_rate
    return yearly.sort_values('Year')
input.summary: Filter for freshwater beaches, normalize Violation column, compute yearly bacterial exceedance rate (violations/total), compute average exceedance rate rounded to 2 decimal places, flag years above average.
